text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is the day of the "wedding" between 
companies that Satono Diamond talked 
about.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to helping out with the "betrothal 
exchange," I was also invited by Satono 
Diamond.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san. Welcome, thank you for 
coming.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. We have invited many guests, 
including members of the mass media.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I will definitely make today's ceremony a 
wonderful one!

text_block_list.name: Media
text_block_list.text:
—Presenting a merger as a "wedding 
ceremony", huh. —Well, it certainly has 
publicity value, but... —All that matters 
now is whether the actual substance 
matches up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The mood in the venue regarding this 
merger is still somewhat cautious, taking 
a wait-and-see stance. However...
choice_data_list:
(I'm sure she can turn the whole mood 
around!)

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"The ceremony is about to begin. We kindly 
ask all guests to please put on the smart 
glasses provided."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following the announcement, I put on the 
smart glasses handed to me at the 
reception desk. My field of vision 
suddenly brightens, and in the next 
moment—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Welcome to our "Wedding Ceremony"!

text_block_list.name: Attendees
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, what is this... MR?! —It really 
feels like we're standing in a church... 
—Whoa, this is fascinating...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe♪ I'm so glad everyone seems 
pleasantly surprised.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
And now—we shall proceed with the "Wedding 
Ceremony" of both companies.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Satono Diamond's introduction, 
representatives from both companies step 
forward.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Both companies possess outstanding 
technologies, serving as central pillars 
of the modern industry. Even so...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
There may be those who harbor concerns 
about two companies with entirely 
different strengths becoming one.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
However— you will be able to experience 
the answer for yourselves ahead.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A vast field of flowers spreads out across 
my entire field of view. Yet, that isn't 
all.

text_block_list.name: Media
text_block_list.text:
—No way? I can even feel the breeze...! 
—Haptic and olfactory sensations through 
smart glasses?! —It's like actually 
standing in another world...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
One side brings the power to envision 
dreams. The other brings the power to make 
those dreams tangible.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
A view that neither could ever reach alone 
is now unfolding before your very eyes.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
What you are witnessing right now is the 
future that lies ahead as both companies 
join hands.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
And now—let us hear the vows to create 
this future spoken by the two 
representatives.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Embracing each other's differences and 
supporting one another— do you vow to 
continue walking together, no matter what 
hardships may come in the future?

text_block_list.name: Both Corporate Representatives
text_block_list.text: —Yes, I do. —Yes, I do.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
All of you gathered here today are the 
witnesses who observe and attest to the 
vows they have made.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Please, offer your warm applause of 
blessing to this brand-new "bond."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—(Clap clap clap clap!) —(Clap clap clap 
clap!) —(Clap clap clap clap!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the ceremony concludes, I call out 
to Satono Diamond as she takes a breather 
outside the venue.
choice_data_list: It was a wonderful ceremony today. Truly!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Fufu...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Everyone who attended the ceremony... had 
completely different expressions from how 
they started.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
To see it received not with anxiety— but 
as a true "blessing"... makes me so happy.
choice_data_list:
It reached them all thanks to your hard 
work.

It reached them all thanks to your hard 
work.
Still, what counts is what happens next.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
No, I couldn't have done it alone. Both 
companies, the media, the guests who 
attended... And above all—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to the wonderful support 
you gave me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. But I know it will be alright. 
Because the expressions on everyone's 
faces from both companies were so full of 
hope.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The future lying ahead is bright. I'm 
certain of it.
